description: Gloves of Faith Level 60 Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Gloves of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Gloves, 8 Wartorn Cloth Scraps and 4 Mooncloth. Requirements: - Desecrated Gloves - Wartorn Cloth Scrap x 8 - Mooncloth x 4
